name: ai.paperlist/paperlist
title: PaperList
description: Search papers from 36 AI conferences, including NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, and CVPR.

tools.name: list_conferences
tools.description: List conferences in Paperlist with their slugs, full names, research domains and available years, including ICLR 2027 (under-review submissions on the public ratings board). Pass topics_for {conference, year} to also get that edition's topic slugs with paper counts (use the slugs as the topic filter in search_papers/list_papers; ICLR 2027 areas are prefixed iclr2027-). No account or API key required.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Full-text search over titles, abstracts, keywords and authors. Quoted phrases stay exact; OR / AND / NOT and parentheses are supported; common ML acronyms (JSCC, RAG, RLHF, VLA, VLM, DPO, MoE, ...) are expanded. Filter by conference slugs, year range (include year 2027 for ICLR 2027 under-review submissions), acceptance type, topic slug, or author name (must match one author). Defaults to slim rows (id, title, venue, year, decision, rating, url) so clients can scan many papers; pass fields=full or call get_paper/fetch for abstracts. If no paper matches enough of the query, the response is empty or clearly marked as a looser fallback, rather than off-topic any-word hits.

query.description: Search words. Quoted phrases stay exact; OR / AND / NOT and parentheses work. Common acronyms (JSCC, RAG, RLHF, VLA, VLM, DPO, MoE, ...) are expanded.

year_from.description: Include ICLR 2027 under-review submissions only when the year range overlaps 2027.

decision.description: Acceptance types to keep (case-insensitive exact match). Common values: Oral, Spotlight, Poster, Highlight, Findings, Main; ICLR 2027 also uses Under review, Desk reject, Withdrawn.

topic.description: Topic slug from list_conferences topics_for (use iclr2027-* for ICLR 2027 primary areas)

author.description: Author name, e.g. "Kaiming He". Must match tokens of one author name.

fields.description: slim (default for list_papers/search_papers/find_similar_papers) returns id, title, conference, year, decision, rating_avg, url, and short topics. Use full or get_paper/fetch for abstracts. Prefer slim when scanning or exporting a conference.

limit.description: Results per page. slim: search up to 200 (default 10), list_papers up to 250 (default 100). full: 1-25 (default 10).

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Get one paper's full record by id (e.g. iclr2026-1058, paper-1058, iclr2027-n42, a numeric catalog id, a paperlist.ai paper URL, or an OpenReview forum id if it is in Paperlist), including the review summary or ICLR 2027 TLDR when available. Slug ids are verified against venue and year, so iclr2026-1 will not silently return an unrelated paper-1.

tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: Browse papers of one conference edition (e.g. conference="iclr", year=2025, or year=2027 for ICLR under-review submissions). Defaults to slim rows (id, title, conference, year, decision, rating_avg, url, short topics) with up to 250 per page; pass fields=full for abstracts (max 25) or use get_paper. Optionally filter by acceptance type or topic slug. For keyword search use search_papers.

decision.description: Acceptance types to keep (case-insensitive exact match). Common values: Oral, Spotlight, Poster, Highlight, Findings, Main; ICLR 2027 also uses Under review, Desk reject, Withdrawn.

fields.description: slim (default for list_papers/search_papers/find_similar_papers) returns id, title, conference, year, decision, rating_avg, url, and short topics. Use full or get_paper/fetch for abstracts. Prefer slim when scanning or exporting a conference.

limit.description: Results per page. slim: search up to 200 (default 10), list_papers up to 250 (default 100). full: 1-25 (default 10).

tools.name: find_similar_papers
tools.description: Find papers related to a given paper, ranked by full-text similarity of its title and keywords. Defaults to slim rows; pass fields=full for abstracts. Optionally restrict to conferences or years.

fields.description: slim (default for list_papers/search_papers/find_similar_papers) returns id, title, conference, year, decision, rating_avg, url, and short topics. Use full or get_paper/fetch for abstracts. Prefer slim when scanning or exporting a conference.

limit.description: Results per page. slim: search up to 200 (default 10), list_papers up to 250 (default 100). full: 1-25 (default 10).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Paperlist papers by keywords. Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: get_topic_stats
tools.description: Trend stats for one research topic across NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML and CVPR, 2023–2026: paper counts by year × venue, year-over-year growth, fastest-growing co-labeled sub-themes, sibling topics in the same area, and ~20 representative papers (title, venue, year, paperlist id). Precomputed snapshot, no live aggregation. Get slugs from list_topics (e.g. world-models, multimodal-llms, reinforcement-learning). For ICLR 2027 primary areas, pass a slug from list_conferences topics_for {conference:"iclr", year:2027} (prefixed iclr2027-).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the 207 research topics that have trend stats, grouped into 40 areas, each with its slug, English and Chinese name, and paper count. Scope: NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML and CVPR, 2023–2026. Use a slug from here with get_topic_stats.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one paper's full text record by id from search.
